name: Four Hundred Years Since Marriage
source:
Camille is a thousand-year-old vampire, adapting to a world in rapid evolution. Habit settles in as she drifts further and further into a simpler, easier routine.

But maybe she’s drifted away from something more important than bagged blood and working from home.

[From [url=https://mashinn.itch.io/four-hundred-years-since-marriage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡米尔是一个一千岁的吸血鬼，适应着一个快速进化的世界。随着她越来越习惯于更简单、更轻松的生活习惯，她的习惯也逐渐形成。

但也许她已经远离了比袋装血液和在家工作更重要的事情。

[来自[url=https://mashinn.itch.io/four-hundred-years-since-marriage]Itch.io[/url]]
